page.layout: One page of continuous running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the first lines and lower down. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: bac ad Orientem Amafi inter Occonem & Tumultus bellici cisul-tiaq; Ama-fum. Foccónem diffenfio ne enata, atq; armis cómo-tis, cum Occonis fortuna labafceret, Focco Gro-ninganis fuccéfens Occone fœdere iunctis, traiectto cum fuis Amafo, & excitata illic factione fua, pralio Groninganos vicit; victorq; in patria rever-fus Occonem in pugnacepit: iterum, primo vere anni M. CCCC. XXVIII, Amafo trafmiffo, aspirante undiq; fortuna, totú pene agrú, qui inter Amafum & Lavicam est, à civitate avertit, & in novas leges ac nova fœdera cum adegit. Sed Medachio-rum, Humerziorum, Longowoldiorum, Fredowoldi-orum multi non assensere, & fœdus etiam cum Fœdus renovatum, Groninganis finito jam fœdere priore, pro libertate & legibus prisctis rurfum pepigere, in quo appella-tio ad Hovetmannos urbanos à judicib. cæ-teris in agro litigantib. permissa, & vt conven-tus juridici quatuor quotanis agantur in vrbe; urq; non nisi voluntaria tributa fint, exigan-turve ab agrariis, statutum. Quo cognito, Focco illuc cum exercitu accurrens disiectis, qui se op-ponere aufi erant, rem turbavit, & in eas angustias civitatem coniecit, ut petitis inducis confulere sibi ipsa necesse habuerit. At dominuregre fo Foccone, Sic notatum in-formulis factorum cū VVinfcota-nis, item cū Holwerdiis & Merfcina- & reb. difficilib. implicito, adeoq; in ordine redacto, omnia priori statui restituta: nominatim cum Fivelgoniis universis, & peculiariter cum Dammonensibus, itemq; cum maxima Hvnesgoniorum parte fœdera repetita Tuibæ ab Hamburgensibus. & conditionib. novis ampliata. Simul Hamavr-Gensib. Emnonis Grethani & filiorum eius focys Endapotitis hominib. negociationu ftudio deditis.

page.notes: Marginal notes read in full on the right side. Several lines are faint and the right-hand notes are small; the word "Endapotitis" at the foot and "Hamavr-" are doubtful. The opening "bac" may be "hac". The page number "83" is printed with a gap that could be read as "8 3".
